svg.title: Sandmeyer chlorination: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Ph–NH2+–N=O + proton relays → Ph–N=N–OH + acid. N-deprotonation and tautomerization produce a diazohydroxide model; solvent proton relays are grouped.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
